title: Access To Homepage Language
description: One language of the homepage app (.github/config/i18n/<lang>.json). en.json is the source; every other language also has a page map, project copy and a journey.<lang>.json, and render-hub.sh builds <lang>/index.html from them. validate-config.sh checks the cross-file rules (same keys as en.json, every listed project, journey ids and crisis lines).

lang.description: ISO 639-1 code; must match the file name

name.description: The language's own name (English, Español), used in the language switch

path.description: Folder of this language's homepage: "" for English, "<lang>/" otherwise

url.description: Canonical URL of this language's homepage (hreflang, canonical, og:url, share links)

keep.description: English strings on index.html that stay the same (names)

page.description: Sections of English text exactly as written in index.html -> translation

ui.description: Words app.js writes at runtime. {name} placeholders must match en.json.

narration.description: Joining phrases narration-clips.sh uses to compose spoken scripts

projects.description: Per listed project (repos.json name): translated description, call to action and audience. Titles are brand names and are not translated.
